package.name: cix_ros_camera
package.description:
ROS 2 camera package for the CIX ISP pipeline. Captures frames over V4L2 with true zero-copy dmabuf transport — image data is never memcpy'd across process boundaries when the broker runs.
Features: - Pure ROS 2 Type Adapter - V4L2 dmabuf capture via EXPBUF (no isp_app linkage) - True zero-copy for intra-process composable nodes - Graceful memcpy fallback for inter-process - UDS broker for true inter-process fd sharing (SCM_RIGHTS)
